# rrffmpeg

> Remote FFmpeg wrapper in Rust. It stands in for `ffmpeg` inside Jellyfin and sends each transcode to the machine that has the GPU, over SSH or through its own agent. Arguments pass through unchanged. It only dispatches: no encoding, remuxing or quality logic.

Update this file in the same change as any doc, config key or feature it lists.
Each entry points at raw Markdown so a reader gets plain text.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vasilvestre/rrffmpeg/main/README.md): what the project is, why it exists, the measured defects it fixes, install and configuration.
- [INSTALL](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vasilvestre/rrffmpeg/main/INSTALL.md): the full install on a client and a worker, the agent daemon, the disk and GPU checks, and the section written for an AI agent.
- [Project page](https://vasilvestre.github.io/rrffmpeg/): the same pitch as HTML, plus the current status section.
- [Measured dispatch latency](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vasilvestre/rrffmpeg/main/docs/latency.md): how much the dispatcher adds to a transcode start, with the commands to repeat the measurement.
- [rffmpeg against rrffmpeg](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vasilvestre/rrffmpeg/main/docs/compare-rffmpeg.md): the same job through both dispatchers, on one controlled box and on the production Jellyfin host and its GPU worker, with the breakdown of rffmpeg's cost and the configs to repeat it.
- [Measurer](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vasilvestre/rrffmpeg/main/scripts/measure.py): 5 warmup runs, N samples, nearest-rank percentiles, used by both benchmark pages.
- [Replay harness](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vasilvestre/rrffmpeg/main/docs/replay.md): records real Jellyfin invocations and replays them through `rrffmpeg` to catch argument, quoting, stream wiring and exit code regressions.
- [Example config](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vasilvestre/rrffmpeg/main/config.example.toml): a working pair of client and worker hosts.
- [Release 0.7.0](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vasilvestre/rrffmpeg/main/docs/releases/0.7.0.md): the journal records fps, speed, source and output shape, and copy or encode per stream.
- [Install script](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vasilvestre/rrffmpeg/main/scripts/install.sh): downloads the latest release, checks the checksum, installs the binaries and the `ffmpeg` links, and keeps the previous binary for a rollback.

## Architecture decision records

- [ADR index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vasilvestre/rrffmpeg/main/docs/adr/README.md): the table of decisions and their status.
- [0001 Stand in for ffmpeg](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vasilvestre/rrffmpeg/main/docs/adr/0001-stand-in-for-ffmpeg.md): exact argument passthrough.
- [0002 Journal off the critical path](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vasilvestre/rrffmpeg/main/docs/adr/0002-journal-off-the-critical-path.md): append-only journal and background flusher.
- [0003 In-process janitor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vasilvestre/rrffmpeg/main/docs/adr/0003-in-process-janitor.md): repair in process, no cron watchdog.
- [0004 Prefix path mapping](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vasilvestre/rrffmpeg/main/docs/adr/0004-prefix-path-mapping.md): longest-prefix mapping in both directions.
- [0005 SSH transport](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vasilvestre/rrffmpeg/main/docs/adr/0005-ssh-transport.md): SSH first, behind a trait.
- [0008 Cross-process slots](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vasilvestre/rrffmpeg/main/docs/adr/0008-cross-process-slots.md): slot files and an expiring down verdict.
- [0009 Agent transport](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vasilvestre/rrffmpeg/main/docs/adr/0009-agent-transport.md): the agent daemon as a second transport.
- [0010 Agent TLS](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vasilvestre/rrffmpeg/main/docs/adr/0010-agent-tls.md): one pinned certificate, one connection per direction, amended by 0018.
- [0011 Journal timings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vasilvestre/rrffmpeg/main/docs/adr/0011-journal-timings.md): timings in the journal, read back by `rrffmpeg-stats`.
- [0012 Shared queue with client weight](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vasilvestre/rrffmpeg/main/docs/adr/0012-shared-queue-with-client-weight.md): ticket queue orders starts.
- [0013 Retry a job that never started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vasilvestre/rrffmpeg/main/docs/adr/0013-retry-a-job-that-never-started.md): move an unstarted job to another host.
- [0014 SSH connection persistence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vasilvestre/rrffmpeg/main/docs/adr/0014-ssh-connection-persistence.md): one long-lived ssh per host, so a job pays a channel open.
- [0015 Journal replay](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vasilvestre/rrffmpeg/main/docs/adr/0015-replay-waits-for-the-janitor.md): the replay runs when the janitor reads it, not at open.
- [0016 Verifiable install and update](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vasilvestre/rrffmpeg/main/docs/adr/0016-verifiable-install-and-update.md): `--version`, a tag check, one install script, and a protocol revision.
- [0017 The queue decides at the door](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vasilvestre/rrffmpeg/main/docs/adr/0017-queue-decides-at-the-door.md): a newcomer queues behind a waiter, and free slots are handed out in a batch, measured at 16 concurrent clients.
- [0018 One thread relays a job](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vasilvestre/rrffmpeg/main/docs/adr/0018-one-thread-relay-and-lazy-stdin.md): the daemon polls both pipes itself, and the stdin connection opens on the first byte.
- [0019 Refuse the local fallback](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vasilvestre/rrffmpeg/main/docs/adr/0019-refuse-the-local-fallback-for-ffmpeg.md): a transcode fails instead of encoding on a client with no GPU; a probe still falls back.
- [0020 SSH arguments in config](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vasilvestre/rrffmpeg/main/docs/adr/0020-ssh-arguments-in-config.md): a per-host key without a wrapper script.
- [0021 Per-host environment](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vasilvestre/rrffmpeg/main/docs/adr/0021-per-host-environment.md): the worker wrapper becomes a config table, and the agent protocol moves to revision 2.
- [0022 Progress sample in the journal](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vasilvestre/rrffmpeg/main/docs/adr/0022-progress-sample-in-the-journal.md): fps, speed, source and output shape, and copy or encode per stream, read from the worker's stderr and shipped to Loki.

## Optional

- [Source](https://github.com/vasilvestre/rrffmpeg): repository root, `src/` holds the dispatcher, `tests/` the replay and fidelity tests.
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vasilvestre/rrffmpeg/main/AGENTS.md): build commands, deployment facts that break dispatchers, and the rules for contributing.
